text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After school,
I start looking for Scarlet so
we can get a head start on
today's
training.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for making you help me out all day.
You were a big help
though, so I
appreciate it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, I'm just happy I was able to
assist. Feel free to rely on me
whenever
you need!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: And with that, I'll be off!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Sigh. They've been running me ragged since morning... Gotta prepare for training now, too—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Eek?! T-Trainer?!
Don't scare me like that!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Geez, did you come here just to get me?
Well, you could have
saved yourself the
effort! I was about to head over anyway.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And just so we're clear—I wasn't tired at
all. It was just your
imagination, a trick of
the light.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Helping people out is kinda like an
everyday thing for me. It's not a
big deal.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I know, I know. You might've forgotten,
but I'm an honor student.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm more dependable than anyone else,
and I never betray their expectations.
Whether it's my conduct, my studies, or
my running—I'm
number one.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That's who Daiwa Scarlet is! So a few
errands aren't enough to faze
me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Instead of prying into my private life,
how
about you focus on my
training?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Y-you did say that when you scouted me...
But didn't you mean
"support" in the
racing sense?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Even then... You don't need to worry about me this m—

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Hey Scarlet! Got a minute?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Wh-what's the matter? Something
wrong?

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
I have to prepare the cooking utensils for
tomorrow's home ec class.
Sorry, but could
you help me real quick?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Sure,
I don't mind! I'll be right there, so
could you go on ahead
without me?

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Yay, thanks a bunch! I'm glad I asked you!
I'll be waiting!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Sorry Trainer, but you should go on ahead
too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's fine,
I got this. And it's not that I don't
want you with me—I just
don't want to
push my work onto others.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So off you go! Get prepped for my
training! I won't take long, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Scarlet promptly shoos me away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thirty minutes later...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Sigh... That took way longer than I thought it would. Okay, let's get started.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Huh, what's wrong? Why're you staring
daggers at me... Are you
mad? I do feel
bad for making you wait, you know.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
N-not even close! Besides, if I can't even
do this much, how am I
supposed to be
number one?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I know I was late,
so let's just train longer
to make up for—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What the heck... You're making me look
like the bad guy here, you
know?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Also... you are my trainer,
so I... d-do r—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, never mind! Now I'm in a bad mood!
Let's just hurry up and start
training!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet—a student set on being
number one. It looks like it'll
take a lot
more time before she learns to count on
me.
